values.note: Read on Campspot: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax. Riverfront and water-and-electric sites $35, 30-amp full hook-up $40, weekday and weekend alike, July and November 2026. 2027 isn't open for booking yet. Plus the park's $6 'Booking Fee', once per stay. Read 2026-10-31.

sites.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/rivertown-campground (18 riverfront + 14 water/electric + 12 full hook-up; every site rvLengthMax 50, every type 'Back-In'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: From Campspot's closed dates: 2026-11-09 to 2027-05-03; last year's ran to May 22. Campspot also closes 2026-05-05 to 05-10 and 2026-08-20 to 08-31, reason not stated.

summary: Confirmed $35-40, 44 sites, 50A, Campspot; changed year_round true->false (closed Nov 9-May 3); added 50-ft max, all back-in.
flags: WATER: stored 'riverview' is an upgrade lead. Campspot sells 18 of the 44 as '30/50 AMP, Riverfront, Water, Electric' (S01-S18), and the operator's site map draws that row as the last thing before the Ohio River, with only grass between. Imagery didn't settle it: the view I got shows no pads in that stretch and a wooded strip along the bank, so it may predate the row. Not plotted to a measurement; the map is schematic.

PIN: stored 38.74545,-85.06477 is Campspot's point, on the road by the playground, between the two site groups (the west column and the east rows). Roughly 200-350 m from each, scaled loosely from the drawn map. Left as a reasonable middle.

SEASON: the closed dates are Campspot's, so they may mean online booking only; the town page gives no season. May closure and the Aug 20-31 closure carry no reason; both could be town events or flooding, I don't know which.
